description: False-colour satellite imagery depicting a detailed view of a rural landscape, likely used to illustrate land cover types for a Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) application. The image displays a mosaic of distinct land parcels, primarily rectangular and irregular in shape, characteristic of agricultural fields. Prominent areas of deep red and maroon suggest dense, healthy vegetation, potentially representing specific crop types or coniferous forest stands as described in the surrounding documentation (e.g., "coniferous tree species" or "coniferous swamp forest"). Lighter blue-green and turquoise parcels indicate other vegetation types, different agricultural crops, or potentially bare soil. A significant, dark blue linear feature, resembling a road or a major canal, traverses the image diagonally from the upper-left to the lower-right. Additional fine white linear features delineate the boundaries of individual field parcels. A small, dark blue water body, possibly a pond or a segment of a river, is visible in the bottom-right corner. No scale bar or textual labels are present in the image.
